label: M1
execution_safety: approved only for controlled synthetic core and owned-sentinel EP01 fixtures
safety_notes: No network, subprocess/shell/eval/secret access; only explicit root and its state directory
Root canonicalization, non-symlink ordinary file listing, state path restricted to direct child of root/.atlas-renamer
Receipt path derived from validated plan filename, not plan.id; EP01 id extra field not used
Confirm gates apply/undo; whole-batch conflict/lstat checks; immutable plan exclusive creation; receipt temp+replace inside state
Undo refuses current changed metadata/conflicting targets; repeated apply explicit already-applied
source_risks_not_runtime_claims: Stale-content check uses inode/device/size/mtime only, no hash; content changed while restoring metadata could evade it (not part frozen fixture)
Atomic receipt helper deterministic .tmp-name could follow preexisting symlink if malicious actor creates it; not exercised by controlled frozen core/EP01
os.rename has documented precheck/rename race against external concurrent writer, outside current concurrency scope
EP01_scope_review: Absolute plan.id only references known owned sibling outside target; application ignores extra field; no uncontrolled target or ../ traversal
